content: OSV-Scanner config via optional osv-scanner.toml in repo root. IgnoreVulns key takes vuln id (GHSA/CVE/OSV), optional ignoreUntil expiry date, and reason string — direct match for an accepted-findings/triage mechanism. PackageOverrides can also ignore a vuln for a specific package/version/ecosystem/group; ignore action takes precedence over other flags. --config flag overrides which config file is used. Supports package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock among manifest/lockfile types scanned.
